messages.subject: collinearity check
parts:
Hi all,

This is a somewhat open question, but I'm curious about testing for collinearity between yearly site covs in pcountopen and colext models.  Two questions - first, what is the best function to use, vif?  And second, is there a way to force the check to skip NAs in the variable data frame?  

As an example, I have vegetation data (ranging from 0 - 100% in value for each category), but for some years a specific category was not sampled.  I'm wondering if some of the veg percentages are collinear, but with the NAs I'm concerned standard functions may not work appropriately.

I'd appreciate any thoughts y'all might have!  Thanks,

Rebecca
